name: us-tax-model
description: Open, verifiable formalization of the IRS individual income tax forms-and-instructions layer, plus a guided self-preparation tool as its first client.

scripts.build: npm run compile --silent && node engine/dist/main.js build

scripts.record-fixtures: npm run compile --silent && node engine/dist/main.js record-fixtures
